ValidationRule.description: Restrict the User, for making the new case as Sensitive.Jira-CRM-5051
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(Sensitive__c, ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New')) && $Profile.Name != 'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name != 'Qantas System Administrator' && $Profile.Name != 'Qantas System Admin - Freight' && $Profile.Name != 'Qantas System Admin - QCC' && $Profile.Name != 'Qantas System Admin - SND'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Can't make a new case as sensitive case
